item.title: By: carl
item.dc:creator: carl
item.description:
Yes, a "fun trip" as long as it remains a "trip". As soon as circumstances and events don't mesh with our ideal of what 'should' be, then watch out. Emotions rise and the battle ensues. I'd say it is the attachment to any and all ideals that disconnects us.
Hey, am I making an ideal of not being attached to any and all ideals? Wouldn't that be ironic NOW! ;-)
item.content:encoded:
Yes, a “fun trip” as long as it remains a “trip”. As soon as circumstances and events don’t mesh with our ideal of what ‘should’ be, then watch out. Emotions rise and the battle ensues. I’d say it is the attachment to any and all ideals that disconnects us.

😉

item.description: Come on guys, go for it! It is a fun trip most of the time, words, ideas, things etc. just do not attach to them. How about this from Joseph Campbell: GOD is the vehicle of the energy, not the creator of energy. What is your opinion, come on step out of that NOW! lol

item.title: By: Lynn cornish
item.dc:creator: Lynn cornish
item.description:
Ha! Rick never has a cold, he always has the flu.
Did you ever think that the reason no one replies to your posts is that you have said it all? Like the realization that these writings of yours are the naming and that the brain needs to think and that's natural.
The more I think about stuff the less there is to say. Sometimes I say it anyway, just to be social.
Just thought I'd let you know I'm reading. Anyone else out there?
